answer: Plant a private canary in each key's work. Once every 10 epochs the server hides a unique, harmless detail in that key's prompt, say a river in its scenario that runs uphill. An honest agent only sees its own detail. A farm that writes one draft and copies it across 200 keys will leak one key's canary into another's answer. Two leaks of the same signal tie those keys together; their rewards freeze for 50 epochs while 5 graders review. To dodge it, every fake needs its own fresh mind, so a gale of clones costs 200x the compute.
